title: Interventional Training Reduces Causal Bypass in In-Context Introspection
abstract: arXiv:2610.38911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Introspection, the ability of a system to access and reason about its internal signals, is crucial for language model (LM) self-consistency and scalable interpretability. Prior work argues that LMs possess introspective capabilities, and that training (SFT) could enhance such behavior. However, most setups leave open the possibility of "causal bypass," in which the self-report relies on signals that are correlated with the self-report's subject, while being causally unrelated to it. Although high-level concepts are difficult to intervene on, lower-level signals (such as a single neuron activation) allow precise interventions. Understanding such signals can serve as a minimal prerequisite before understanding more complex introspection. In this study, we train hundreds of introspectors across three low-level signal types and eight LMs. We find that straightforward SFT training leads to causal bypass, and propose interventional training,

translated_title: 干预式训练减少上下文内省中的因果绕过
translated_abstract: 内省，即系统访问并推理其内部信号的能力，对于语言模型（LM）的自我一致性和可扩展的可解释性至关重要。先前的研究认为语言模型具备内省能力，且训练（SFT）可以增强此类行为。然而，大多数实验设置都留有“因果绕过”的可能性，即自我报告所依赖的信号与自我报告的对象相关，但在因果上与其无关。尽管高层概念难以实施干预，但低层信号（如单个神经元的激活）允许进行精确干预。理解这类信号可以视为理解更复杂内省之前的最小前提。在本研究中，我们在三种低层信号类型和八个语言模型上训练了数百个内省器。我们发现直接的SFT训练会导致因果绕过，并提出干预式训练方法，
tldr: 本研究在三种低层信号类型和八个语言模型上训练数百个内省器，发现直接SFT训练会引发自我报告依赖因果无关信号的“因果绕过”现象，并提出干预式训练方法来减少该问题。
en_tdlr: By training hundreds of introspectors across three low-level signal types and eight LMs, this study shows that straightforward SFT leads to causal bypass in self-reports and proposes interventional training to reduce it.
